messages.content: Before you book San Diego, read back the three names, dates, flight total, and the Coronado charges. I want to make sure the taxes and cancellation cutoff did not move.

The travelers are Marcus Lee, Daniel Lee, and Owen Lee. The itinerary is Saturday, June 14 through Friday, June 20. The selected outbound leaves Chicago O'Hare at 8:05 a.m. Saturday and arrives in San Diego at 10:28 a.m. The return leaves San Diego at 4:55 p.m. Friday and arrives at O'Hare at 10:53 p.m. Airfare remains $2,214 for all three, including $264 in taxes and fees. No tickets have been issued yet.
Are all three names exactly as they appear in the saved traveler records? No middle-name mismatch for Owen?
Yes. The records show Marcus Lee, Daniel Lee, and Owen Lee, with no middle name entered for Owen. The birth dates and other required traveler details are complete and match the saved profiles.
Now the hotel. Confirm it is six nights, not the earlier Friday-to-Friday search, and that they will actually make up the sofa bed.

Correct: six nights, checking in Saturday, June 14 and checking out Friday, June 20. Best Western Plus Suites Hotel Coronado Island confirmed a king suite for three occupants. The double sofa sleeper will be prepared for Owen before arrival, and the quoted rate covers all three guests.
Break down the $2,284.26 and give me the cancellation language with the actual deadline.

The six-night room subtotal is $1,896.00, lodging taxes are $256.26, and parking is $132.00, for a complete hotel total of $2,284.26. There is no resort charge. Breakfast for all three guests is included. Cancellation is free through 6:00 p.m. Pacific on Thursday, June 12; after that, the property charges one night's room and tax.
And the combined amount is $4,498.26, correct? Nothing else mandatory at the hotel?

Correct. Airfare of $2,214.00 plus lodging, taxes, and parking of $2,284.26 equals $4,498.26. There are no additional mandatory hotel fees in the rate terms. Incidental purchases and any parking beyond the six booked nights would be separate.
Keep the airport, zoo, and waterfront timing with the reservation too. Read those back before I authorize it.

From San Diego airport, the hotel transfer is estimated at 15-25 minutes by car, depending on traffic. The San Diego Zoo is about 20-25 minutes by car. Coronado Ferry Landing is roughly a 10-minute walk from the hotel; the ferry crossing to the downtown waterfront takes about 15 minutes, with departures subject to the operating schedule.
That all matches. Book the Saturday flights for Marcus Lee, Daniel Lee, and Owen Lee, and reserve the Coronado king suite for three with the sofa bed request. Use the saved payment method.

Before I submit, one final authorization check: the saved payment method will be charged $2,214.00 now for nonrefundable airfare. The hotel reservation totals $2,284.26, with payment handled under the property's rate terms and free cancellation through 6:00 p.m. Pacific Thursday, June 12. Shall I complete both transactions?

Both are booked. Flight confirmation SD7K4P covers Marcus Lee, Daniel Lee, and Owen Lee for Saturday, June 14, ORD 8:05 a.m.-SAN 10:28 a.m., returning Friday, June 20, SAN 4:55 p.m.-ORD 10:53 p.m. Total airfare charged: $2,214.00, including $264.00 in taxes and fees. Hotel confirmation BW-583174 is for six nights at Best Western Plus Suites Hotel Coronado Island, king suite for three, with the double sofa sleeper preparation request confirmed for Owen. The hotel total is $2,284.26: $1,896.00 room, $256.26 taxes, and $132.00 parking. Breakfast for three is included, there is no resort fee, and free cancellation ends at 6:00 p.m. Pacific on Thursday, June 12. Combined trip total: $4,498.26. The file also retains the 15-25 minute airport transfer, 20-25 minute zoo drive, 10-minute walk to Ferry Landing, and approximately 15-minute ferry crossing to the downtown waterfront.
